## Import



WAF api sec sensitive custom api exclude rule can be imported using the domain#ruleName, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Waf/apiSecSensitiveCustomApiExcludeRule:ApiSecSensitiveCustomApiExcludeRule example www.example.com#tf-example
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
